take: New Jersey announced that D Anton Silaev was recalled from Utica (AHL), D Johnathan Kovacevic went on injured reserve, and D Seamus Casey moved to long-term injured reserve. Kovacevic has played 13 games with 2 assists, and at 5-on-5 NJD has had 58.63 percent of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice. In the one game since he went out, Brenden Dillon is up to 18:31 a night from 11:28 and Declan Chisholm is up to 16:42 from 12:40, with Dougie Hamilton moving in beside Chisholm. We have no numbers on Silaev or Casey.
